Maine Property Tax Relief Explorer

Analysis of changes to Maine’s property tax relief programs on behalf of the Real Estate Property Tax Relief Task Force

Local build, 25 November 2026. This copy of the Relief Explorer shows the results of a model run on this computer, not the published version. Every chart and table is computed from this run; the written descriptions are from the published version and may not match it.

Prepared for the Maine Legislature’s Real Estate Property Tax Relief Task Force by Stephen Hoskins (Progress & Poverty Institute) and Greg Miller (Center for Land Economics), as contractors to the Task Force.

Source for every exhibit: a model of Maine households built by the Progress & Poverty Institute and the Center for Land Economics from the Census Bureau’s American Community Survey (2020 to 2024) and Maine Revenue Services records, applying the property tax relief rules in force for 2026.
